name: Buy-side
schedule: Continuous (reconciles the CRM every 5 min; reminders fire 09:00-18:00 Jakarta)
description: Buy-side automation. Watches buy-side opportunities and, as they move through the pipeline, creates tasks and fires timed reminders / overdue escalations into the buy-side Google Chat space. Also runs follow-up chases, no-show rebooking, and 90-day re-engage, and detects calendar bookings + email replies. Reads the CRM every 5 minutes. Runs as a standalone Docker container on the VM (it is NOT a Twenty workflow).

name: Sell-side
schedule: Continuous (reconciles sell deals every 5 min; reminders 09:00-18:00 Jakarta)
description: Sell-side outbound cadence, in the same engine container. Watches the sellOpportunity object; creates tasks + posts reminders to the sell-side Chat space. Cadence: 1st reach-out -> 2nd (+2 business days) -> 3rd (+5 bd) -> Ghosted/re-engage in 2 weeks -> +5 bd -> park 3 months -> 3-month re-engage -> +3 bd -> DNC. Any reply intercepts to a meet-to-understand-needs task; terminal cleanup on Closed Won/Lost or DNC.

name: Fulfillment
schedule: Continuous (reconciles fulfillment every 5 min; reminders 09:00-18:00 Jakarta)
description: Fulfillment automation, running in the same engine container. Watches the Fulfillment object; on stage/Progress-Type changes it creates tasks (separate Fulfillment list) and posts timed follow-up reminders to the fulfillment Google Chat space. Cadence: chase on days 2, 4, 8, 12 and 26; if still quiet, a 14-day re-engage then one more full cycle, then dormant. Inbound replies are intercepted instantly, pausing the chase; everything is snapped to 09:00-18:00 Jakarta. Terminal cleanup when Outcome is set or Progress = Complete. A daily 06:35 cron refreshes each record's Last Contact + Days Since Contact.

name: Blocklist Guard
description: Enforces the cold-email sending-domain blocklist. The admin's CRM blocklist (Settings > Accounts > Blocklist, vilca@nobridge.co) is the master list; this mirrors it to every workspace member and soft-deletes any Company/Person auto-created from a blocked @domain (skips records attached to real deals/notes). Deleted ids logged to swept.json.

name: Client-Type Sync
description: Keeps the 5 pipeline boards in step with each Company's Client Type tags: tagging a company auto-creates its deal on that board, and deleting a deal from a board removes that tag from the company (so deletes stick). This is what the Sales Engine keys off to decide which deals to act on.

name: Call Intelligence
description: Reads each staff member's Google Meet Gemini call notes, writes a summary note onto the matching Company, Contact and deal record, and queues the call's follow-ups for approval on the dashboard's Calls tab.

name: CRM Database Backup
description: The only backup of the entire CRM database. Fixed 2026-08-06 after 73 nights of silent failure; now refuses to keep an undersized dump.

name: Last Contacted Refresh
description: Recalculates the Last Contacted wording on every deal, and the days since contact on fulfillment records.

name: Gmail Draft Cleanup
description: Removes the phantom sent emails the CRM creates each time you autosave a draft reply.

name: Finance Database Backup
description: Nightly backup of the Nobridge Finance database, which is separate from the CRM.

name: Ops Dashboard
description: This site. Read-only view of every automation, plus call approvals.

name: Claude Connector (Ops)
description: The connector that lets Claude read and write the CRM in conversation. Runs inside the sales engine.

name: Nobridge Finance
description: The finance app at fin.nobridge.co — submissions, approvals and payment tracking.

name: Web Front Door
description: Handles HTTPS and routes each domain to the right application. All three sites depend on it.

name: CRM Interface Overlay
description: Our branding and interface fixes, layered over the stock CRM. The CRM server itself is unmodified.
